Let me check routes and how the Vue app does login. Let me look at how the installer's previous log showed the POST succeeded (there was a "sessions create" at 09:27:03 etc). So the route exists. Maybe POST /users/sign_in requires the route to be defined as a resource, and my earlier grep found `Devise::SessionsController#create` in logs. The 404 might be due to missing CSRF token? No, that'd be 422. 404 suggests the route didn't match — maybe because the format needs to be html and I sent content-type form encoded which is fine... Actually, curl -d defaults to content-type application/x-www-form-urlencoded which is fine.

Wait — maybe the issue: Devise routes are mounted but POST /users/sign_in returns 404 because... let me check config/routes.rb and app/controllers. Actually the log at 09:27:03 shows "Processing by Devise::SessionsController#create" — wait, it showed the User Load query under action='create',controller='sessions'. So POST works from the browser (Vue fetch). The Vue app probably POSTs via fetch to /users/sign_in with JSON. Let me check the Vue login code to replicate.
